info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Miargyri Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Miargyri Drill Detail Catalog API facilitates the creation of detailed records for Miargyri drill equipment. This endpoint allows users to input essential data about various drill specifications, ensuring that the catalog remains comprehensive and up-to-date. Ideal for manufacturers, equipment managers, and project planners, the API streamlines the process of maintaining drill inventory. By utilizing this API, your organization can enhance operational efficiency and improve data management practices related to drill equipment.

post.summary: Create new details for the Miargyri drill.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit and create new detail entries related to the Miargyri drill. It processes the provided data to update or establish new information specifically for the drill project.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to send details for the miargyri drill operation. The expected format is JSON, containing the necessary parameters for processing the drill details.

200.description: The request was successful, and the requested details are returned.

CreateCatalogMiargyriDrillDetailRequest.title: Drill Operations Request

miargyri_drill_id.description: The unique identifier of the miargyri drill.

requestedBy.description: The name or identifier of the person requesting the drill operations.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the drill.

CreateCatalogMiargyriDrillDetailRequest.description: Schema representing a request body for drill operations, including identification, requester information, and quantity details.

CreateCatalogMiargyriDrillDetailResponse.title: Operation Response

status.description: The status of the operation, indicating success or failure.

recordId.description: A unique identifier for the record created or processed by the operation.

processedAt.description: The timestamp when the operation was processed.

matchedCount.description: The number of records that matched the criteria specified in the operation.

CreateCatalogMiargyriDrillDetailResponse.description: The response object for a successful POST operation, containing details on the status and processing of the request.

content-type.description: Indicates the media type of the returned content.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
